description: Sign and notarize Tommy's macOS apps, CLIs and .pkg installers for distribution outside the Mac App Store: Developer ID certificates made from ONE global private key, App Store Connect API key for notarytool, temporary keychain signing, hardened runtime entitlements, stapling, and Gatekeeper checks on another Mac. Also covers creating certificates and API keys on developer.apple.com and App Store Connect with Playwriter. Use when the user asks to sign, codesign, notarize, staple, make a .pkg or .dmg, fix "Apple could not verify", create or renew a Developer ID certificate, or create an App Store Connect API key.
